author: Gutherz & Blackman, 1970

note.en: A 7.5 cm whiff of shelf bottoms at 35 to 200 m that ranges south to Nicaragua and Guyana; known here only from Bussing & López's guide.
note.es: Un lenguado de 7,5 cm de fondos de plataforma entre 35 y 200 m que llega al sur hasta Nicaragua y Guyana; conocido aquí solo por la guía de Bussing y López.

evidence: Added: not in the original species list
Listed for Costa Rica's Caribbean coast by Bussing & López (2010), whose guide is based on University of Costa Rica museum specimens

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2): 190-193 (Paralichthyidae)
